title: Artificial Intelligence and Data Science | Saylani Mass IT Training
text: Course: Artificial Intelligence and Data Science. Category: Development. Duration: 10 months. Description: A complete 8-10 month training program from Python programming fundamentals to advanced AI technologies: Python, Data Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, MLOps, Big Data, Cloud Computing, Generative AI, and Agentic AI. This course is offered free of cost by Saylani Mass IT Training (SMIT), an initiative of Saylani Welfare International Trust. Admission is via the online registration form at https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll, selecting this course and a preferred campus/city. (Source: SMIT official AI data feed, saylanimit.com/llms-full.txt)
